story.title: How Google helped destroy adoption of RSS feeds (2023)

draft:
I still miss the simplicity of RSS feeds for staying up to date on my favorite sites. 
Google's shutdown of Google Reader in 2013 marked a significant decline in RSS adoption. 
This move forced users to rely on social media and newsletters instead. 
What's the best way to revive interest in RSS feeds?
